evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.9 ppm after remaining near 3–6 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen rose successively to 6.7, 13.4, and 20.3 ppm during growth despite unchanged argon setpoint.
Oxygen continued rising through 25.9 ppm at 2880 s to 33.3 ppm, indicating a sustained departure from the established purged baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon 100.5 sccm track setpoints; pressure remains near baseline at 760.6 Torr and status is running, so these channels do not explain the oxygen rise.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and checks of inlet gas purity and seal integrity are needed to distinguish air ingress from contamination, outgassing, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
